[SWS_DM_00116] Clearing a
DTC group
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04117
⌈
When the DM is about to clear a
DTC group
it shall apply the same clear operation
process as for a single DTC on all the DTCs of the
DTC group
which is cleared.
⌋
